description: This source file implements the core functions for a Ping diagnostic tool within a broadband management system. It includes functions to start, open, stop, close, expire, calculate results, and set environment for the ping test, handling both IPv4 and IPv6 protocols, managing socket operations, and maintaining echo entries and timing information.

classes.name: BBHM_DIAG_IP_PING_OBJECT
classes.description: Main object managing the ping diagnostic process, including socket management, timing, echo entries, and result calculation.

classes.name: PBBHM_IP_PING_PROPERTY
classes.description: Properties/configuration for the ping operation, such as packet size, number of packets, timers, and status.

classes.name: PBBHM_IP_PING_ECHO_ENTRY
classes.description: Records each echo request/response with sequence ID, start/stop time, packet size, TTL, and ICMP type.

classes.name: PBBHM_IP_PING_SINK_OBJECT
classes.description: Object handling the socket and network communications for ping.

classes.name: PDSLH_PING_INFO
classes.description: Structure holding detailed diagnostic information, including success/failure counts and response times.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagipStart(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Starts the ping operation; initializes socket, prepares ICMP packet, and begins sending packets.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagipOpen(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Opens the socket and prepares the ping environment for operation.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagipStop(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Stops the ping, calculates results, closes socket, and updates diagnostic state.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagipClose(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Closes socket and cleans up resources used by the ping object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagipExpire1(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Handles the expiration of a ping packet and re-sends it with updated sequence number.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagipExpire2(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Handles the overall timeout for the ping operation, transitioning to timeout state.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagipSetStopTime(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,USHORT SeqNumber,ULONG PktSize,UCHAR TTL,ULONG StopTime)
methods.description: Records the stop time and other packet info for a specific echo entry identified by sequence number.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagipAddEchoEntry(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,USHORT SeqNumber,ULONG StartTime)
methods.description: Adds a new echo request entry with sequence number and start time.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagipCalculateResult(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Calculates the ping results: min, max, average RTT, and final success/failure counts.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BbhmDiagipSetEnv(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Sets or updates environment parameters for the ping object; no specific implementation here.
